description: Errors of the Khronos validation layer an encode may report and still pass, when it runs under the layer (vvs_test_runner.py --validation-layer, or a sample's "validation_layer": true). An entry names an error by its VUID, which may hold shell wildcards, and may narrow it to codecs, to the layer versions that report it (min_layer_version and max_layer_version, compared with the api_version of the layer's manifest) and to a substring of the message (message). Every entry gives its reason. See libs/video_test_validation_layer.py.

encode.reason: False report for a unidirectional compound picture whose reference pair has a picture in DPB slot 0, such as LAST_FRAME and GOLDEN_FRAME with LAST_FRAME in slot 0: the layer takes slot index 0 for an unused reference name (it tests referenceNameSlotIndices[i] > 0 instead of >= 0). The 1.4.313 and 1.4.357 layers report it; Vulkan-ValidationLayers 2afb6caba2 fixes it, first in the 1.4.363 SDK.
